newsitem.title: JAPAN: Woodland to provide software to NEC - paper.
newsitem.headline: Woodland to provide software to NEC - paper.

text.p: Computer software maker Woodland Corp will provide NEC Corp with sales management software for small- and medium-sized companies which NEC would sell under its own brand name, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
The industrial daily Nikkei Sangyo Shimbun said that Woodland hoped to double its sales of the software in the next business year from annual sales of 1,000 units currently.
The paper said that Woodland already provides the software to Fujitsu Ltd. Woodland officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
